pregnancy_groups.note: From the outreach log: counts of sessions and attendances only, found by the word 'pregnant' in the event description. There is no separate register, so some sessions may be missing.

birth_and_pregnancy.note: As the mother told it at the first home visit. Paper form 2017-2019, Kobo form from 2021; there are no first visit forms for 2020. These are the mothers Chimalaya visited, not every birth in the area.

illness_in_pregnancy.types_note: Mothers can name more than one illness. Anaemia and pre-eclampsia were never recorded, which is probably under-reporting.

first_visit_trends.note: From the first home visit, as the nurse recorded it. Paper form 2017-2019 and Kobo form from 2021; there are no first visit forms for 2020. A year with fewer than 30 answers is left out.

growth_chart.note: Mean weight of the children weighed, by year of the visit, on the WHO weight-for-age percentile curves (2nd, 5th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 95th, 98th). A point needs at least 10 children. The grey line is the mothers' group children of all years together. Each point is a different group of children, so a line is not one child growing.

origin.note: Renting is a stand-in for coming from outside Bode: the form asks whether the mother lives in rent and, if so, which district she is from. Kobo form only, since 2021.
